sources.title: Mirazur — official
sources.claim: Mirazur 3★, 30 avenue Aristide Briand, Menton; the Italian-border address.

sources.title: Mirazur Universe Menu
sources.claim: Universe Menu rotates lunar-aligned variations: Root/Leaf/Fruit/Flowers.

sources.title: Mirazur — reservations
sources.claim: €450 deposit policy: free cancel up to 15 days, then €450/person charged.

sources.title: Mirazur — MICHELIN
sources.claim: Mirazur 3-star, Menton — MICHELIN Guide 2026.

sources.title: World's 50 Best — Mirazur
sources.claim: Mirazur ranked No.1 in The World's 50 Best Restaurants in 2019.

sources.title: Mirazur Universe Menu price
sources.claim: Universe Menu is €450 per person, lunch or dinner.

sources.title: Mirazur commitments
sources.claim: First restaurant globally with Plastic Free; first 3★ with B Corp.

sources.title: Hostellerie Jérôme
sources.claim: 2★ at La Turbie, 14 minutes west of Menton by car.

sources.title: Hostellerie Jérôme — MICHELIN
sources.claim: Hostellerie Jérôme — 2 stars 2026.

sources.title: Le Louis XV — Monaco
sources.claim: Le Louis XV — Alain Ducasse, 3★ Mediterranean, Hôtel de Paris Monaco.

sources.title: Le Louis XV — MICHELIN
sources.claim: Le Louis XV — 3 stars (Monaco Guide 2026).

sources.title: Blue Bay Marcel Ravin
sources.claim: Blue Bay — 2★ at Monte-Carlo Bay, Caribbean-Mediterranean (Marcel Ravin).

sources.title: SNCF Connect — Monaco/Menton
sources.claim: 17 trains/day, 9 km in 10 minutes.

sources.title: Menton → Ventimiglia
sources.claim: ~9 minutes, frequent service from 06:04.

sources.title: Nice → Menton
sources.claim: ~36 min average (32 min fastest), 46 services/day.

sources.title: Cannes → Menton
sources.claim: 1h09 fastest / 1h27 avg, 42 services/day.

sources.title: Monaco–Monte-Carlo → Menton
sources.claim: Monaco → Menton: 10–11 minutes, 46 direct services/day.

sources.title: Zou! bus 600 — Nice/Monaco/Menton
sources.claim: Bus 600 every 10–15 min weekdays, €2.10 contactless.

sources.title: Menton's six Jardins Remarquables
sources.claim: Maria Serena, Serre de la Madone, Fontana Rosa, Clos du Peyronnet, Val Rahmeh, Les Colombières.

sources.title: Serre de la Madone
sources.claim: Apr–Oct, daily 10–18 (closed Mon), €10 self-guided / €15 guided.

sources.title: Val Rahmeh — MNHN
sources.claim: Open Apr–Oct 10–18 (closed Tue + 1 May), ~1,800 sub-tropical species.

sources.title: Maria Serena
sources.claim: Guided tour only via Office de Tourisme; Tue/Thu/Sat 10–11:30.

sources.title: Fontana Rosa
sources.claim: Guided tour by phone reservation only, €6/person.

sources.title: Jardin des Colombières
sources.claim: Wednesdays at 2pm (Apr–Oct), €20, online booking only, capped at 15.

sources.title: Clos du Peyronnet (Waterfield)
sources.claim: Open only Fridays of September & October at 3pm; NOT visitable in May 2026.

sources.title: La Citronneraie / Mas Flofaro
sources.claim: Jardin Remarquable since 2008; 800+ species + lemon orchard; visits by appointment.

sources.title: Le Bastion — Musée Jean Cocteau
sources.claim: Daily 10–12:30 and 14–18 (closed Tue); 17th-century fortin on the jetty.

sources.title: Wunderman exhibit @ Palais de l'Europe
sources.claim: ~100 Wunderman masterworks; Galerie des musées, runs until 27 Aug 2026.

sources.title: Salle des Mariages
sources.claim: Cocteau-decorated wedding room (1956–58); weekdays 8:30–12 and 14–16:30, €2.

sources.title: Musée Cocteau still shut
sources.claim: Ricciotti Wunderman building closed since Storm Adrian (Oct 2018); no reopening before 2030.

sources.title: Citron de Menton IGP — INAO
sources.claim: IGP since 21 Sept 2015 across Menton, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, Gorbio, Castellar, Sainte-Agnès.

sources.title: Maison Herbin
sources.claim: Mon–Sat 9:30–12:30 / 14–19, Sun 10–12:30 / 15–18; artisan jam-maker since 1974.

sources.title: Au Pays du Citron
sources.claim: Founded 2008; ~200 references; Limoncello de Menton ~50,000 bottles/yr.

sources.title: Maison Gannac
sources.claim: Boutique 10 rue Saint-Michel; year-round; IGP lemons, limoncello, oils.

sources.title: Fête du Citron 2026
sources.claim: 14 Feb–1 Mar 2026 — outside any late-May trip window.

sources.title: Menton old-town walking route
sources.claim: Basilique Saint-Michel (1639) + Pénitents Blancs (1680) + Vieux Château cemetery.

sources.title: Basilique Saint-Michel-Archange
sources.claim: Built 1640–1653; minor basilica, Catholic parish of the historic core.

sources.title: Plage des Sablettes
sources.claim: ~350 m of very fine gravel along Quai Bonaparte; summer-lifeguarded.

sources.title: Menton beaches index
sources.claim: Plage du Fossan, Sablettes, Hawaï, Plage du Marché along the coast.

sources.title: Marché des Halles
sources.claim: Daily 8–13, year-round; ~30 indoor merchants + 15–25 seasonal producers.

sources.title: Jardin Exotique reopened
sources.claim: Monaco's Jardin Exotique reopened 30 March 2026 after €18M, six-year refit.

sources.title: Musée Océanographique de Monaco
sources.claim: Founded 1910 by Prince Albert I; aquarium + panoramic Rocher terrace.

sources.title: Prince's Palace Grand Apartments
sources.claim: Open 30 March–15 October 2026.

sources.title: Ready For IT 2026
sources.claim: Monaco, Grimaldi Forum, 2–4 June 2026 — CIO/CISO/CTO one-to-ones.

sources.title: WAIB Summit 2026
sources.claim: Monaco One Monte-Carlo, 9–10 June 2026; Web3/AI/digital assets.

sources.title: WAICF 2026
sources.claim: Cannes, Palais des Festivals, 12–13 Feb 2026; 10,000+ visitors.

sources.title: Cap Martin coastal path
sources.claim: 4.7 km one-way, ~50 m gain, easy; Carnolès → Cabbé past Cap Moderne.

sources.title: Cap Moderne
sources.claim: Villa E-1027 / Le Corbusier Cabanon — 2.5 h guided tour, €15, 4×/day Apr–Oct.

sources.title: Ventimiglia Friday Market
sources.claim: Italy's largest open-air street market — 500+ stalls, 8am–~16:30.

sources.title: Sainte-Agnès, highest coastal village in Europe
sources.claim: 800 m altitude — among the Plus Beaux Villages.

sources.title: Bus 10 to Sainte-Agnès
sources.claim: Bus 10 from Menton Gare Routière reaches Sainte-Agnès in ~40 min.

sources.title: Fort Sainte-Agnès
sources.claim: Maginot Line bunker, 2,000 m² galleries under 55 m of rock; Wed–Sun tours.

sources.title: Riviera hilltop villages
sources.claim: Castillon 706 m + Caramel viaduct 13 arches; Castellar last French perched village.

sources.title: Bus 15 to Castillon/Sospel
sources.claim: Bus 15 Menton → Castillon ~30 min.

sources.title: Palais de l'Europe — Menton Congrès
sources.claim: Books medical/architectural congresses (JAS, PILM, ICQC, IWOAI) — no IT.

sources.title: Sciences Po Menton
sources.claim: Middle-East/Mediterranean politics — not IT.

sources.title: French Tech Côte d'Azur calendar
sources.claim: Riviera tech calendar — Feb, Apr, Jun, Jul, Oct are the live windows.

sources.title: Riviera DEV 2026
sources.claim: SKEMA Sophia Antipolis, 6–8 July 2026 — developer conference.
